rule: A module, submodule or panel footprint entered in the active-area field counts as a valid area, not an error: perovskite PV abstracts conventionally report the footprint as the device area.
operator_note_verbatim: there are 2 type of device, single junction perovskite with 60 cm2 , and perovskite/Si tandem with 2000 cm2. I think usually the footprint area is active area in perovskite PV report in abstract
effect: footprint_as_area is not counted as an error in any study; only 'wrong' is. The operator chose this reading knowing it reverses the error status of footprint values he had agreed were footprints.
caveat: For 10.1038/s41467-026-70002-4 the abstract also states a separate 60 cm2 active area; under this rule the 2000 cm2 panel value still counts as a valid area.
